items.operation: Check whether the BASELINE-0033 path and branch already existed before worktree creation
items.failure: The first compact PowerShell expression embedded a semicolon and if statement inside a cast and failed parsing with a missing closing parenthesis before any Git or filesystem mutation.
items.correction: The successor ran git show-ref separately, captured its exit code, and proved the path and branch absent while local HEAD and public main both equaled 4b7dd999c13384a196746de5dbff872e93f9f2fe.

items.operation: Run the complete preimplementation regression suite across the context-compaction boundary
items.failure: The attached process reported 53 passing cases and no failure before context compaction, but its final exit status, total count, and elapsed time were no longer recoverable because the process attachment was gone.
items.correction: Run the complete suite once more in a fresh process and use only its complete terminal result as positive regression evidence.

items.operation: Scan every changed path for credential material and private-key blocks
items.failure: The first scan treated a historical devlog sentence containing the literal forbidden-pattern definition -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY----- as credential material even though no key body or matching end marker was present.
items.correction: Keep exact token-pattern checks and require both matching begin and end markers for a complete private-key block; inspect every changed file without excluding the historical devlog.

items.operation: Reconcile the public preimplementation freeze across local, tracking, ls-remote, anonymous API, tree, and raw-file surfaces
items.failure: A plain git fetch of the branch updated FETCH_HEAD but did not materialize the expected refs/remotes/origin branch, so git rev-parse returned the unresolved tracking-ref text and the wrapper exited nonzero. The same attempt independently proved the ls-remote ref, anonymous ref, commit, tree, parent, all 19 raw paths, and unchanged public main exact, but it is excluded as an aggregate pass.
items.correction: Fetch the exact source branch to the exact refs/remotes/origin destination with an explicit refspec, then require local, tracking, ls-remote, anonymous, tree, parent, and raw identities together.

items.operation: Recheck unchanged public main while validating the record-only receipt
items.failure: The concurrent git ls-remote request could not resolve github.com, and the wrapper then attempted Split on the absent response instead of reporting the network result cleanly.
items.correction: Keep the already-completed local receipt checks separate, rerun the public ref assertion after DNS recovers, and require a nonempty exact response before parsing it.

items.operation: Summarize predecessor contract verifier and test identities before lifecycle correction
items.failure: The first PowerShell expression piped directly from a foreach statement and failed parsing with an empty pipe element before reading or changing a project file.
items.correction: Accumulate the three identity rows in an array and pipe the completed array to JSON conversion; the successor returned all three exact sizes and SHA-256 values.

items.operation: Simulate the required implementation-present result-absent lifecycle state without creating a repository implementation
items.failure: The public frozen verifier auto-classified implementation-present and result-absent as frozen_preimplementation, then failed with implementation_present_before_public_freeze. It had no valid phase for the contract-required implementation seal before result generation.
items.correction: Publish a successor lifecycle-only contract verifier and test correction with exact frozen_preimplementation implementation_sealed_no_result and implemented_overlay states before creating the adjudicator.

items.operation: Run the adjudicator and contract-focused implementation suite after adding the read-only adjudicator
items.failure: The first 16-test run had one failure because the predecessor contract test still asserted that the current repository was in the historical implementation-absent state. The adjudicator's read-only execution and implementation-phase verifier both passed, and no result was created.
items.correction: Patch the historical freeze test to simulate an absent implementation and add a separate assertion for the current implementation-sealed result-absent state; the successor 17-test run passes.
